name: inbox_download
description: Download one file from a public https URL so it can be used inside the Sandbox. Nothing is opened or run on this computer: the file goes into a shared inbox that the Sandbox sees read-only, and a few seconds later it is copied to the Sandbox desktop folder Input and checked against its SHA-256 (Desktop\input-check.html shows OK or FAIL). Run or open it only from Desktop\Input inside the Sandbox, and only when its line says OK. A .zip is not unpacked here; unpack it inside the Sandbox. At most 50 MiB; private and local addresses are refused.

url.description: https URL of the file, e.g. the vendor's official download link.
